heading.html: What Is a Men’s Korean Body Scrub?

children.text: Over time, our skin builds up layers of dead skin cells and impurities. Without exfoliation, these layers continue to build up and cause skin issues. A men’s Korean body scrub isn’t your average scrub—it’s a full-body spa treatment for men, rooted in Korean spa culture, that uses vigorous scrubbing and deep exfoliation to target buildup, rough patches, and impurities, revealing smoother and healthier skin underneath.

children.text: Never had a Korean scrub before? Here’s how it works—and why it’s become a must-have ritual for many men. Here’s a step-by-step breakdown:

children.text: Relax in our hot tubs inside the men’s bathhouse for at least 15–20 minutes to soften the skin and maximize exfoliation results.
Your scrub attendant will guide you to the scrub table. They’ll use an abrasive scrub mit, called an ‘Italy towel’, to exfoliate every area of your body, removing dead skin and buildup.
After the scrub, you’ll be rinsed off and cleaned with warm water to wash away any debris.

heading.html: What to Know Before Your First Korean Body Scrub

children.text: If you’re new to Korean body scrubs, it’s normal to have a few questions. At King Spa, we want you to feel completely at ease. Here are the key things to know before your first appointment:

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-5e310369 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.html:
Nudity Is Part of the Experience

Guests are nude during the scrub for more effective exfoliation and scrub treatments are performed in gender-separated areas. This is standard in Korean spa culture and is handled professionally and respectfully by our trained staff.

It Feels Intense—But In a Good Way

The scrub uses a textured glove to remove dead skin. It’s firm and thorough, especially on dry or rough areas. It may feel intense at first, but most guests say it’s deeply satisfying and refreshing.

Don’t Apply Lotions or Shave Beforehand

Avoid using lotions, creams, or oils before your appointment. Also, don’t shave on the day of your scrub—freshly shaved skin can feel more sensitive during the treatment.

Hydrate and Moisturize Afterward

Drink water after your session and apply a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer. Avoid sun exposure, exfoliating again, or using strong products for a few days so your skin can recover.

heading.html: FAQ: Men’s Korean Body Scrub at King Spa

children.html:
Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, A Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

Is it normal to be nude during the scrub?

Yes. Korean body scrubs are traditionally performed without clothing in gender-separated areas. It’s handled with professionalism and respect.

What is the cost of a men’s body scrub treatment?

You’ll feel firm pressure, but it shouldn’t be painful. Most guests describe it as intense but refreshing.

What should I do before my appointment?

Avoid applying lotions or oils beforehand, and skip shaving the day of your treatment to reduce skin sensitivity.

What should I expect after the treatment?

Your skin will feel extremely smooth and refreshed. Be sure to moisturize afterward and avoid heavy sun exposure or strong exfoliants for a few days.

Can I combine the body scrub with other treatments?

Yes! Many guests add oil treatments, body shampoos, or massages to complete their spa experience.

How often should men get a Korean body scrub?

We recommend a full body scrub every 4–6 weeks to maintain smooth, healthy skin, depending on your skin type and lifestyle.

What types of men’s body scrubs do you offer?

We offer several body scrub treatments, including the Classic Scrub, the CBD Oil Scrub for extra hydration and relaxation, and the King Scrub for an enhanced, deluxe experience.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.

How can I book a men’s body scrub treatment at King Spa?

All of our spa treatments are booked on-site and are first-come, first-served. Please visit us at our reservation desk on the second floor to book your treatment. We recommend arriving early to secure your spot.
